summary: Milestone 2B backend verification: 49/49 pytest tests PASS (14 M1 + 15 M2A + 20 new M2B). All M2B backend surfaces verified: admin/accountant login + /auth/me roles; users list/create/update/delete owner-gated (admin & accountant get 403; cannot delete owner role); admin CAN create employees, accountant CANNOT (403); shifts seeded (General/Morning/Night) + owner-only CRUD; holidays seeded (Republic Day, Independence Day) + owner-only CRUD; ledger add/list with running balance verified (+bonus 500, -advance 200 == +300 delta on closing_balance); payroll compute row shape (13+ fields incl. base_salary/present_days/half_days/sunday_work/leave_days/effective_days/earned/bonus/advance/fine/manual_deduction/net_salary); admin cannot compute/save (403); accountant CAN save/lock; lock rejects re-save (400); accountant cannot unlock (403); owner unlocks; mark-paid inserts salary timeline event; PDF endpoint returns application/pdf with %PDF magic bytes; unsaved GET returns computed preview with saved:false. FRONTEND CRITICAL BUG: admin/accountant login triggers 'Maximum update depth exceeded' redirect loop — (tabs)/_layout.tsx and index.tsx only allow role==='owner' and bounce every other role to /(emp)/home, contradicting the spec 'admin/accountant share owner tabs'. As a result the entire admin/accountant frontend is unusable; UI could not be exercised for M2B screens under those roles. Owner-role frontend flows (payroll tab, ledger, shifts, holidays, users) were not re-verified after the redirect loop discovery. test_credentials.md was updated to include admin/accountant.

ui_bugs.issue: RBAC gate uses `user.role !== 'owner'` and redirects admin/accountant to /(emp)/home. Spec: 'Admin/accountant share owner tabs'. This creates a redirect loop with (emp) layout and throws React 'Maximum update depth exceeded'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:15.
Root index has same bug: `user.role === 'owner' -> /(tabs)/dashboard else -> /(emp)/home`. Should send owner+admin+accountant to /(tabs)/dashboard. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:14-15.

After successful login it routes based on `mode`, not on returned `user.role`. If admin/accountant logs in via 'owner' mode form, they will hit the broken (tabs) gate. Recommend routing off user.role from response: owner|admin|accountant -> /(tabs)/dashboard, employee -> /(emp)/home. Reference: /app/frontend/app/login.tsx:32-38.

integration_issues.issue: Blocked by redirect loop above. Frontend M2B screens (payroll tab, payroll detail, ledger, ledger-new, users, shifts, holidays) could NOT be exercised end-to-end under admin/accountant. Backend RBAC for those endpoints is verified via pytest.

react_native_issues.issue: Uncaught 'Maximum update depth exceeded' error at login as admin — caused by mutually-recursive router.replace() between /(tabs)/_layout, /(emp)/_layout, and /index.tsx role gates. Same infinite-loop pattern would also fire for accountant.

rca_of_issue: Root cause: RBAC hierarchy was expanded on backend (owner+admin+accountant staff) but the frontend routing layer still uses a binary owner-vs-employee model. app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:15 does `if (user.role !== 'owner') router.replace('/(emp)/home')` and app/(emp)/_layout.tsx presumably does the mirror check for employee, so admin lands in (tabs), gets bounced to (emp), which bounces back — React detects the setState loop and throws 'Maximum update depth exceeded'. Reproduction: open /login → tap 'Owner' mode → username=admin, password=Admin@123 → tap Log in. URL remains /login and a red LogBox appears. Mitigation: relax the check to `user.role === 'employee'` (redirect only employees away from tabs) OR use an explicit allow-list of staff roles. Also update /login onSubmit to route by returned user.role, not by the UI mode toggle.
